summary.zh: 杨坚接受北周禅让，建立隋朝。
summary.en: Yang Jian accepted the Northern Zhou abdication and founded the Sui.

description.zh: 581 年，北周外戚杨坚接受静帝禅让，建立隋朝，改元开皇，仍都长安。日期与经过为通行说法，待页码级核对。
description.en: In 581, Yang Jian, a relative of the Northern Zhou imperial family, accepted Emperor Jing’s abdication, founded the Sui, and kept Chang’an as the capital. Dates and details follow conventional accounts and await page-level verification.

summary.zh: 隋军攻入建康，陈朝灭亡，南北统一。
summary.en: Sui forces entered Jiankang, ending the Chen dynasty and reunifying north and south.

description.zh: 589 年，隋军分路南下，攻入建康，陈后主被俘，陈朝灭亡，结束自西晋末年以来近三百年的分裂。日期与路线为通行说法，待页码级核对。
description.en: In 589, Sui forces advanced south along several routes and entered Jiankang. Emperor Houzhu of Chen was captured, ending the Chen dynasty and nearly three centuries of division since the fall of Western Jin. Dates and routes follow conventional accounts and await page-level verification.

name.en: Emperor Yang of Sui opens the Tongji Canal

summary.zh: 隋炀帝开凿通济渠，连接洛阳与淮河。
summary.en: Emperor Yang of Sui opened the Tongji Canal, linking Luoyang with the Huai River.

description.zh: 605 年，隋炀帝下令开凿通济渠，自洛阳引谷、洛水入黄河，再引黄河水入淮河，成为隋唐大运河的核心河段。日期与路线为通行说法，待页码级核对。
description.en: In 605, Emperor Yang of Sui ordered the Tongji Canal to be dug, linking Luoyang with the Yellow River and then the Huai River. It became a core section of the Sui-Tang Grand Canal. Dates and routes follow conventional accounts and await page-level verification.

summary.zh: 隋炀帝征高句丽，围攻辽东城不克。
summary.en: Emperor Yang of Sui campaigned against Goguryeo but failed to take Liaodong.

description.zh: 612 年，隋炀帝亲征高句丽，隋军渡辽水围攻辽东城，久攻不下，此后接连失利，成为隋末动乱的导火索之一。日期与路线为通行说法，待页码级核对。
description.en: In 612, Emperor Yang of Sui personally campaigned against Goguryeo. Sui forces crossed the Liao River and besieged Liaodong but failed to take it, and later defeats contributed to the unrest that ended the Sui. Dates and routes follow conventional accounts and await page-level verification.

summary.en: Li Yuan proclaimed himself emperor at Chang’an and founded the Tang.

description.zh: 618 年，李渊在长安称帝，建立唐朝，改元武德，随后逐步平定各地割据势力。日期与经过为通行说法，待页码级核对。
description.en: In 618, Li Yuan proclaimed himself emperor at Chang’an, founded the Tang, and adopted the Wude era name. He then gradually subdued regional rivals. Dates and details follow conventional accounts and await page-level verification.

summary.zh: 李世民在虎牢关击败窦建德，奠定统一基础。
summary.en: Li Shimin defeated Dou Jiande at Hulao Pass, laying the basis for unification.

description.zh: 621 年，李世民率军围洛阳，窦建德率军来援，李世民抢占虎牢关，击败窦建德并俘之，洛阳王世充随后投降。日期与经过为通行说法，待页码级核对。
description.en: In 621, Li Shimin besieged Luoyang. Dou Jiande marched to relieve it, but Li Shimin seized Hulao Pass, defeated and captured Dou, and Wang Shichong at Luoyang then surrendered. Dates and details follow conventional accounts and await page-level verification.

summary.zh: 李世民在玄武门发动政变，随后即位。
summary.en: Li Shimin launched a coup at Xuanwu Gate and soon became emperor.

description.zh: 626 年，秦王李世民在长安玄武门伏杀太子李建成、齐王李元吉，迫使唐高祖立其为太子，不久即位，是为唐太宗。日期与经过为通行说法，待页码级核对。
description.en: In 626, Li Shimin ambushed and killed Crown Prince Li Jiancheng and Prince Li Yuanji at Xuanwu Gate in Chang’an, forced Emperor Gaozu to name him crown prince, and soon ascended the throne as Emperor Taizong. Dates and details follow conventional accounts and await page-level verification.

name.en: The Tang destroy the Eastern Turks

summary.zh: 唐军击败东突厥，颉利可汗被俘。
summary.en: Tang forces defeated the Eastern Turks and captured Illig Qaghan.

description.zh: 630 年，李靖率唐军出阴山，突袭东突厥牙帐，颉利可汗败走被俘，东突厥灭亡。日期与路线为通行说法，待页码级核对。
description.en: In 630, Li Jing led Tang forces across the Yin Mountains and attacked the Eastern Turkic camp. Illig Qaghan fled and was captured, ending the Eastern Turkic Khaganate. Dates and routes follow conventional accounts and await page-level verification.

summary.en: Princess Wencheng married Songtsen Gampo of Tubo.

description.zh: 641 年，唐太宗以文成公主嫁吐蕃赞普松赞干布，公主经青海入藏，促进唐蕃和亲与文化交流。日期与路线为通行说法，待页码级核对。
description.en: In 641, Emperor Taizong sent Princess Wencheng to marry Songtsen Gampo of Tubo. She traveled through Qinghai to Lhasa, promoting peace and cultural exchange between Tang and Tubo. Dates and routes follow conventional accounts and await page-level verification.

summary.zh: 安禄山在范阳起兵，南下攻唐。
summary.en: An Lushan rose at Fanyang and marched south against the Tang.

description.zh: 755 年，平卢、范阳、河东三镇节度使安禄山以讨杨国忠为名在范阳起兵，率军南下，安史之乱爆发。日期与路线为通行说法，待页码级核对。
description.en: In 755, An Lushan, military governor of three northern garrisons, rose at Fanyang in the name of removing Yang Guozhong and marched south, beginning the An–Shi Rebellion. Dates and routes follow conventional accounts and await page-level verification.

summary.en: The imperial guards mutinied at Mawei Post as Emperor Xuanzong fled west.

description.zh: 756 年，安禄山军攻破潼关，唐玄宗西逃，禁军在马嵬驿哗变，杀杨国忠，逼死杨贵妃，玄宗随后入蜀。日期与经过为通行说法，待页码级核对。
description.en: In 756, An Lushan’s forces broke through Tong Pass. Emperor Xuanzong fled west, and the imperial guards mutinied at Mawei Post, killing Yang Guozhong and forcing Yang Guifei’s death before the emperor continued to Sichuan. Dates and details follow conventional accounts and await page-level verification.

summary.en: Zhang Xun and Xu Yuan held Suiyang, blocking the rebels’ southward advance.

description.zh: 757 年，安史叛军围攻睢阳，张巡、许远率军坚守数月，城破殉难，但牵制叛军，保全江淮财赋之地。日期与经过为通行说法，待页码级核对。
description.en: In 757, An–Shi rebels besieged Suiyang. Zhang Xun and Xu Yuan held the city for months before it fell and they died, but their resistance tied down rebel forces and protected the Jiang-Huai revenue region. Dates and details follow conventional accounts and await page-level verification.

summary.en: Tubo forces exploited Tang weakness in the northwest and briefly occupied Chang’an.

description.zh: 763 年，吐蕃军乘唐廷忙于平定安史余部，攻入长安，唐代宗出逃，吐蕃军占据十五日后退出。日期与路线为通行说法，待页码级核对。
description.en: In 763, while the Tang court was preoccupied with the remnants of the An–Shi Rebellion, Tubo forces entered Chang’an. Emperor Daizong fled, and the Tibetans withdrew after about fifteen days. Dates and routes follow conventional accounts and await page-level verification.

summary.en: Shi Chaoyi’s defeat and suicide ended the An–Shi Rebellion.

description.zh: 763 年，史朝义在唐军追击下兵败自杀，安史之乱结束，但河北藩镇割据局面由此形成。日期与经过为通行说法，待页码级核对。
description.en: In 763, Shi Chaoyi was defeated and took his own life while fleeing Tang forces, ending the An–Shi Rebellion. The aftermath left powerful military governors entrenched in Hebei. Dates and details follow conventional accounts and await page-level verification.

summary.zh: 杨炎推行两税法，改革赋税制度。
summary.en: Yang Yan introduced the Two-Tax System, reforming Tang taxation.

description.zh: 780 年，唐德宗采纳杨炎建议，推行两税法，按户等与田亩征税，分夏、秋两季缴纳，改变了以人丁为主的租庸调制。日期与制度为通行说法，待页码级核对。
description.en: In 780, Emperor Dezong adopted Yang Yan’s proposal and introduced the Two-Tax System, taxing households and land and collecting in summer and autumn, replacing the head-tax-based zu-yong-diao system. Dates and institutions follow conventional accounts and await page-level verification.

description.en: In 875, Huang Chao rose at Yuanju in response to Wang Xianzhi’s rebellion and campaigned through the Yellow-Huai and Jiangnan regions before marching north and taking Chang’an in 880. Dates and routes follow conventional accounts and await page-level verification.

description.en: In 880, Huang Chao’s forces entered Chang’an. Emperor Xizong fled to Chengdu, and Huang Chao proclaimed himself emperor of the Qi dynasty, though he failed to secure control of the Guanzhong region. Dates and details follow conventional accounts and await page-level verification.

summary.en: Zhu Wen deposed Emperor Ai and founded Later Liang, ending the Tang.

description.en: In 907, Zhu Wen, military governor of Xuanwu, deposed Emperor Ai, proclaimed himself emperor, and founded Later Liang, ending the Tang and beginning the Five Dynasties and Ten Kingdoms period. Dates and details follow conventional accounts and await page-level verification.
